An '''apartment''' was owned and maintained by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his wife, [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] at the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] from [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]]. Their son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], was possibly raised here.
